fullPassage: Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing "eco-friendly" products, probably because they feel licensed to do so since they morally account the "eco-friendly" choice as a "good" deed. Moral licensing has also been observed in the context of cooperation for the good of the environment. When people are reminded of deeds they have done that they know were harmful to the environment, they might be left with a feeling of "eco-guilt." People who experience eco-guilt seek pro-environmental actions to compensate for this guilt and restore balance. In their search for such a balance, people are reluctant to believe in "quick-fixes," because they want to re-establish the moral balance and escape the guilt as quickly and easily as possible. In the same way that people may change their attitudes to reduce inconsistencies between attitudes and behavior, people may also change their evaluation of past environmentally burdening behaviors and future environmentally friendly behaviors. For instance, people are more likely to sign a petition addressing environmental damage after viewing evidence of human-caused environmental damage.

det.korean: evidence = 증거. proof = 증거, 증명 → 동의어예요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① doubt(의심): evidence와 반대되는 느낌이에요

❌ ② opinion(의견): 사실에 기반한 evidence와 달라요

❌ ③ guess(추측): 근거가 부족한 추측과 evidence는 달라요

✅ ④ proof(증거): evidence의 동의어예요 ←정답
det.tip: evidence = proof = 증거. 근거 있는 사실을 가리켜요

questions.passage: Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing "eco-friendly" products, probably because they feel licensed to do so since they morally account the "eco-friendly" choice as a "good" deed. Moral licensing has also been observed in the context of cooperation for the good of the environment. When people are reminded of deeds they have done that they know were harmful to the environment, they might be left with a feeling of "eco-guilt." People who experience eco-guilt seek pro-environmental actions to compensate for this guilt and restore balance. In their search for such a balance, people are reluctant to believe in "quick-fixes," because they want to re-establish the moral balance and escape the guilt as <u>quickly</u> and easily as possible. In the same way that people may change their attitudes to reduce inconsistencies between attitudes and behavior, people may also change their evaluation of past environmentally burdening behaviors and future environmentally friendly behaviors. For instance, people are more likely to sign a petition addressing environmental damage after viewing evidence of human-caused environmental damage.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 quickly와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 re-establish와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

questions.passage:

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 밑줄 친 account의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) account = ~로 간주하다(regard as). (B) account (for) = 설명하다(explain).
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 계좌: account가 명사 '계좌'로 쓰인 게 아니라 동사로 쓰였어요

❌ ② (A) 보고하다, (B) 계좌: 둘 다 문맥에 안 맞아요

✅ ③ (A): 간주하다 (B): 설명하다 — 두 문맥 모두 정확해요 ←정답

❌ ④ (A) 간주하다는 맞지만 (B) 계좌는 틀렸어요 — account for는 '설명하다'예요
det.tip: account: ~로 간주하다(account A as B), 설명하다(account for), 계좌(bank account), 보고서(a detailed account)
